403.label: Restricted access
403.title: This space is protected.
403.description: You do not have permission to open this page. Return to your workspace, or contact your administrator if you believe you should have access.
403.hint: Access is managed by your account permissions. Refreshing will not change them.
403.illustration: A shield and lock representing a protected learning space
404.label: Page not found
404.title: A little off the learning path.
404.description: The page you are looking for may have moved, or the link may be incorrect. Your next discovery is still within reach.
404.hint: Check the address, or start again from a familiar place.
404.illustration: A compass marking an uncharted route on the learning grid
500.label: Internal server error
500.title: Something went wrong.
500.description: We could not load this page because of an unexpected problem. You can return home or try opening the page again.
500.hint: If the problem continues, take a short break and try again later.
500.illustration: A disconnected server representing an unexpected interruption
503.label: Service unavailable
503.title: A short pause. Not the end.
503.description: This service is temporarily unavailable. Maintenance or a temporary interruption may be in progress. Please check back in a little while.
503.hint: No need to keep refreshing. Give it a moment before trying again.
503.illustration: Tools representing maintenance of the learning workspace
retryFailed: The page is still unavailable. Please try again later.
footer: Keep your curiosity. Find your next step.
